description_en: Submits a preset template analysis job
description_zh: 提交预置模板分析作业
kebab_example: aliyun mts submit-analysis-job --input '{"Bucket":"example-bucket","Location":"oss-cn-hangzhou","Object":"example.flv"}' --analysis-config '{"QualityControl":{"RateQuality":25,"MethodStreaming":"network"}}' --user-data testid-001 --pipeline-id bb558c1cc25b45309aab5be44d190000 --priority 10 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitAnalysisJob

parameters.help_en:
The input information about the preset template analysis job to be submitted. The value must be a JSON object. You must log on to the Object Storage Service (OSS) console to grant the read permissions on the specified OSS bucket to MPS. For more information, see the "Input" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html topic.

The OSS bucket must reside in the same region as your MPS service
parameters.help_zh:
作业输入，JSON对象。需在OSS控制台Bucket授权页面将Bucket读权限授权给媒体转码服务。更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html。

OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en: The job configurations. Set this parameter as required. For more information, see the "AnalysisConfig" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html topic
parameters.help_zh: 模板分析作业配置，根据您的实际需要按需设置。更多参数信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: analysis_config

parameters.help_en: The custom data. The custom data can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and can be up to 1,024 bytes in length. The custom data cannot start with a special character
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，可以使用中英文、数字、中划线（-）等，不能以特殊字符开头，最大长度1024个字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MPS queue to which the job is submitted. To view the ID of the MPS queue, log on to the MPS console and choose Global Settings > Pipelines in the left-side navigation pane. If you want to enable asynchronous notifications, make sure that the MPS queue is bound to a Message Service (MNS) topic
parameters.help_zh: 管道ID，可以通过MPS控制台>全局设置>管道查看。如果需要异步通知，须保证此管道绑定了可用的消息主题
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the job in the MPS queue to which the job is submitted.

Valid values: 1 to 10. A value of 10 indicates the highest priority.
Default value: 6
parameters.help_zh:
任务在其对应管道内的转码优先级。

取值范围：[1,10]，10为最高优先级。
默认值：6
parameters.name: priority

AnalysisJob.description_en: The information about the preset template analysis job that was submitted
AnalysisJob.description_zh: 系统预置模板分析作业

PropertiesControl.description_en: The control on the attributes of the job output

Crop.description_en: The cropping configurations of video images

Height.description_en:
The height of the video after the margins were cropped out.

This parameter is invalid if the Mode parameter is set to Auto or None
Height.description_zh:
裁切后高。

若Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Left.description_en:
The left margin that was cropped out.

This parameter is invalid if the Mode parameter is set to Auto or None
Left.description_zh:
裁切左边距。

若Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Mode.description_en:
The cropping mode. Valid values:

Auto: Cropping was automatically run. This is the default value.
Force: Cropping was forced to run.
None: Cropping was forced not to run
Mode.description_zh:
裁切方式。取值：

Auto：自动（默认）。
Force：强制。
None：强制不做

Top.description_en:
The top margin that was cropped out.

This parameter is invalid if the Mode parameter is set to Auto or None
Top.description_zh:
裁切上边距。

若Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Width.description_en:
The width of the video after the margins were cropped out.

This parameter is invalid if the Mode parameter is set to Auto or None
Width.description_zh:
裁切后宽。

若Mode为Auto或None，则此值失效

Deinterlace.description_en:
Indicates whether deinterlacing was forced to run. Valid values:

Auto: Deinterlacing was automatically run.
Force: Deinterlacing was forced to run.
None: Deinterlacing was forced not to run
Deinterlace.description_zh:
强制扫描模式判定。

Auto：自动。
Force：强制做deinterlace。
None：强制不做deinterlace

QualityControl.description_en: The quality control on the job output

MethodStreaming.description_en:
The playback mode. Valid values:

network: online playback
local: playback on local devices
Default value: network
MethodStreaming.description_zh:
播放方式。

network：在线。

local：本地。

默认值：network

RateQuality.description_en: The quality level of the output file

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the job failed. This parameter is not returned if the job was successful
Code.description_zh: 分析失败时错误码。分析成功时不返回此参数

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the job was created

Id.description_en: The ID of the template analysis job

InputFile.description_en: The information about the job input

Bucket.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket

Location.description_en: The ID of the OSS region

Object.description_en: The name of the OSS object that is used as the input file

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The message sent by MNS to notify users of the job result
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成的结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the job failed. This parameter is not returned if the job was successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 失败时错误码。分析成功时不返回此参数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the job failed. This parameter is not returned if the job was successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 失败时错误信息。分析成功时不返回此参数
ErrorMessage.example: The resource operated \"PipelineId\" cannot be found

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the message returned if the job was successful. This parameter is not returned if the job failed
MessageId.description_zh: 成功时消息ID。分析失败时不返回此参数

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the job failed
Message.example: The resource operated \"PipelineId\" cannot be found

PipelineId.description_en: The ID of the MPS queue to which the analysis job was submitted

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the job in the MPS queue to which the job was submitted.

Valid values: 1 to 10. A value of 10 indicates the highest priority.
Default value: 10
Priority.description_zh:
任务在其对应管道内的优先级。

取值范围：[1,10]。10为最高优先级。

默认值：10

State.description_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

Submitted: The job is submitted.
Analyzing: The job is being run.
Success: The job is successful.
Fail: The job fails
State.description_zh:
作业状态。

Submitted：已提交。

Analyzing：分析中。

Success：分析成功。

Fail：分析失败

Template.description_zh: 作业输出的预置模板列表

items.description_en: The information about the preset template
items.description_zh: 作业输出的预置模板详细信息

Bitrate.description_en:
The audio bitrate of the output file.

Unit: Kbit/s.
Default value: 128
Bitrate.description_zh:
输出文件的音频码率。

单位：Kbps。
默认值：128

Channels.description_en: The number of sound channels. Default value: 2

Codec.description_en: The audio codec format. Default value: acc
Codec.description_zh: 音频编解码格式。默认值：aac

Profile.description_en: The codec profile of the audio. Valid values if the Codec parameter is set to aac: aac_low, aac_he, aac_he_v2, aac_ld, and aac_eld
Profile.description_zh: 音频编码预置。当Codec为aac时可取值：aac_low、aac_he、aac_he_v2、aac_ld、aac_eld

Qscale.description_en: The level of quality control on the audio

Samplerate.description_en:
The sampling rate.

Unit: Hz.
Default value: 44100
Samplerate.description_zh:
采样率。

单位：Hz。
默认值：44100

Id.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template

Gif.description_en: The transmuxing configurations for the GIF format

FinalDelay.description_en: The interval between two consecutive loops for the GIF format. Unit: 0.01s. For example, a value of 500 indicates 5 seconds
FinalDelay.description_zh: gif的loop间隔，单位为百分之一秒，比如500代表间隔为5秒

Loop.description_en: The number of loops for the GIF or WebP format. Default value: 0
Loop.description_zh: gif与webp循环次数，默认不循环

Duration.description_en: The length of the segment. Unit: seconds

State.description_en:
The status of the template.

Normal: The template is normal.
Deleted: The template is deleted
State.description_zh:
模板的状态。

Normal：正常。

Deleted：已删除

TransMode.description_en: The transcoding mode. Valid values: onepass, twopass, and CBR. Default value: onepass

Bitrate.description_en: The average bitrate of the video. Unit: Kbit/s

BitrateBnd.description_en: The average bitrate range of the video

Max.description_en: The upper limit of the total bitrate. Unit: Kbit/s

Min.description_en: The lower limit of the total bitrate. Unit: Kbit/s

Bufsize.description_en:
The size of the buffer.

Unit: KB.
Default value: 6000
Bufsize.description_zh:
缓冲区大小。

单位：Kb。
默认值：6000

Codec.description_en: The video codec. Default value: H.264

Crf.description_en:
The constant rate factor.

Default value if the Codec parameter is set to H.264: 23. Default value if the Codec parameter is set to H.265: 26.
If this parameter is returned, the setting of the Bitrate parameter is invalid
Crf.description_zh:
码率-质量控制因子。

默认值：编码格式为H264，默认值为23。编码格式为H265，默认值为26。

如果设置了Crf，则Bitrate的设置失效

Degrain.description_en: The strength of the independent noise reduction algorithm

Fps.description_en:
The frame rate.

The value is 60 if the frame rate of the input video exceeds 60.
Default value: the frame rate of the input video
Fps.description_zh:
帧率。

当输入文件帧率超过60时取60。
默认值：取输入文件帧率

Gop.description_en: The maximum number of frames between two keyframes. Default value: 250
Gop.description_zh: 关键帧间最大帧数。默认值：250

Height.description_en:
The height of the video.

Unit: pixel.
Default value: the height of the input video
Height.description_zh:
视频高。
单位：px。
默认值：视频原始高度

Maxrate.description_en: The maximum bitrate of the video. Unit: Kbit/s

PixFmt.description_en: The pixel format for video color encoding. Valid values: standard pixel formats such as yuv420p and yuvj420p
PixFmt.description_zh: 视频颜色格式。包含yuv420p，yuvj420p等标准颜色格式

Preset.description_en: The preset video algorithm. Valid values: veryfast, fast, medium, slow, and slower. Default value: medium
Preset.description_zh: 视频算法器预置。支持veryfast（超快）、fast（快）、medium（中等）、slow（慢）、slower（超慢）。默认值：medium

Profile.description_en:
The codec profile. Valid values:

baseline: applicable to mobile devices.
main: applicable to standard-definition devices.
high: applicable to high-definition devices.
Default value: high
Profile.description_zh:
编码级别。

baseline：针对移动设备。
main：针对标准分辨率设备。
high：针对高分辨率设备。

默认值：high

Qscale.description_en: The level of quality control on the video

ScanMode.description_en:
The scan mode. Valid values:

interlaced
progressive
ScanMode.description_zh:
扫描模式。取值：

interlaced：交叉扫描。

progressive：顺序扫描

Width.description_en:
The width of the video.

Unit: pixel.
Default value: the width of the input video
Width.description_zh:
视频宽。

单位：px。
默认值：视频原始宽度
